input:
Earlier scenes:
(none)

This scene:
古代的时候，孟子和孟母住了在靠墓地的家。孩子才五岁就每天在墓地祭拜了。在那个城市，孟母从早到晚都找工作，可是找不到，害得孟母没有钱。难怪她跟孩子搬家，原来买不了房。他们搬了到别一个城市找工作。

The teacher's corrections on this scene (student words：her correction, her note):
- 古代的时候，孟子和孟母住了在靠墓地的家：在古代，better to briefly introduce “孟子” when this character first appears；住在靠近墓地的地方/墓地附近，delete了，在+Place
- 孩子才五岁就每天在墓地祭拜了：孟子，孩子is vague and unclear
- 难怪她跟孩子搬家，原来买不了房：wrong information, 搬家因为孟母觉得it is not good to imitate how to offer sacrifices
- 他们搬了到别一个城市找工作：搬到了，另外一个城市，“别（的）” is for “a different type”, and “all else except the spoken one”, whereas “另外“ is for “addition in quantity”, and “another, the other”

The system's feedback items:
1. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 古代的时候：在古代，The original redundantly combines a historical-time noun with a time-frame phrase; use the shorter time expression.
2. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 跟孩子搬家：带着孩子搬家，Use this when the mother takes her child with her during the move; the original wording suggests that the child is an equal companion in carrying out the move.
3. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 别一个城市：另一个城市，Use this expression for one different/additional city; the original word is used to distinguish other people or things from a particular one.
4. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 孟子和孟母：有一个小男孩叫孟子，他和妈妈，First mention should briefly introduce the character by name and identity before later references.
5. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 孩子：他，Use a pronoun for a close re-occurrence when the previous sentence has clearly named only one child.
6. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 在那个城市：在孟子住的城市里，A first mention of this city needs a full noun phrase because the reader has not yet been told which city it is.
7. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 害得孟母没有钱：害得她没有钱，Use a pronoun for a close re-occurrence of the same character within the sentence.
8. [Coherence: temporality, error] Coherence (Temporality): 住了在靠墓地的家：住在靠近墓地的家里，A continuing residence is a state, so it takes the zero particle rather than 了; use 在 before the location phrase.
9. [Coherence: temporality, error] Coherence (Temporality): 每天在墓地祭拜了：每天在墓地祭拜，A routine marked by 每天 takes the zero particle, not completed-action 了.
10. [Coherence: temporality, error] Coherence (Temporality): 搬了到：搬到了，With a resultative complement, place 了 after the complement: verb plus resultative plus 了.

items.reason: 古代和的时候语义重复，改成“在古代”正确。
“跟孩子搬家”可以自然地表示母亲和孩子一起搬家，并非错误。
“别一个城市”不合适；“另一个城市”是正确说法。
首次出现人物应作简要介绍，但改后的“有一个小男孩叫孟子，他和妈妈”本身未完成。
“孩子”在这里指称不够明确，紧接前文改用“他”可以正确指孟子。
前文已经交代他们居住的地点，“在那个城市”可指该居住地所在的城市，并不一定需要改。
孟母刚在同一句中出现，后面用“她”比重复名字更符合近距离指称规则。
居住状态不该用“了”，且应说“住在”某处；改句正确。
“每天”表示习惯性动作，不能在这里用完成体“了”。
趋向补语结构中“了”应放在“到”之后，故“搬到了”正确。
